entry.name: hid
entry.description: Provides input from human interface peripherals (i.e. Trackpad, Keyboard, and others). The hid object is similar to the legacy hi object but is cross platform with more information and capabilities. This includes providing usage pages, usages, types, and ranges for the information received. (see https://www.usb.org/hid for more information)
